text:
ana: Opening PR to align terminology and snippet params across docs. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712

chris: Thanks — what canonical term are we picking?

ana: Proposal: use 'model identifier' in prose and `model_id` in API/examples. Add glossary entry mapping older terms (model_name, model_handle).

matt: SGTM. For SDKs, show API field first then a small mapping callout per language. Keeps canonical surface consistent.

chris: Can we also standardize error voice? Suggest short, active sentences: 'We're routing your request to a different model.' for fallbacks, and 'We're unable to fulfill this request right now.' for failures.

ana: Yep — adding a tiny style rule in the PR and one-line examples. Will include a `sed` one-liner to help replace `model_name` across repos.

doc-bot: PR 712 created by ana, reviewers requested: @chris, @matt. CI checks queued. :gear:

kevin: Tiny nit: use contractions in UI text (we're) but expand in legal/contract docs. Add note in style guide.

ana: Done — pushing updates. Will announce in #docs-updates after merge. :tada:
